description: This file contains functions for interacting with browser session data via HTTP requests, including fetching console messages, PDF saving, error reporting, network requests, tracing, highlighting, and response bodies. It defines multiple exported async functions and imports types and utilities from related modules.

methods.name: buildQuerySuffix
methods.description: Constructs a URL query string from an array of key-value pairs, handling boolean and string types.

methods.name: browserConsoleMessages
methods.description: Fetches console messages from the browser session with optional filtering by level, targetId, and profile.

methods.name: browserPdfSave
methods.description: Requests a PDF save operation for the specified targetId and profile.

methods.name: browserPageErrors
methods.description: Retrieves page errors, with optional clearing and profile filtering.

methods.name: browserRequests
methods.description: Fetches network requests with optional filtering by targetId, filter, clear, and profile.

methods.name: browserTraceStart
methods.description: Starts a tracing session with options for screenshots, snapshots, sources, and profile.

methods.name: browserTraceStop
methods.description: Stops a tracing session, optionally saving to a specified path.

methods.name: browserHighlight
methods.description: Highlights a DOM element specified by ref, targetId, and profile.

methods.name: browserResponseBody
methods.description: Fetches the response body for a given URL and targetId, with optional timeout and maxChars.
